_note: Limits for public reports, to stop spam. A phone is identified by a random id it keeps, not by personal data.
_photo_note: A photo counts as already sent when its fingerprint differs by this many of 64 points or fewer. Copies, re-saved or resized photos differ by 0 to 1; a new photo of the same leak by 10 or more.
_snap_note: A spot just outside every zone outline still belongs to the nearest zone if one of its pipes is within this many metres.
